rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the physical device, such as an alkaline battery.

example.english: I bought a battery for the remote.
example.traditional: 我買咗粒電池畀部遙控器。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 nap1 din6 ci4 bei2 bou6 jiu4 hung3 hei3

rows.note: Use 電 for the charge or power remaining in a device, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: My phone is almost out of battery.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 zau6 faai3 mou5 din6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for an array or series of tests conducted for the same purpose.

example.english: The research team arranged a battery of tests to see whether the new drug is safe.
example.traditional: 研究團隊安排咗一系列測試，睇下新藥安唔安全。
example.jyutping: jin4 gau3 tyun4 deoi6 on1 paai4 zo2 jat1 hai6 lit6 caak1 si3 tai2 haa5 san1 joek6 on1 m4 on1 cyun4
